title: Hydroxylation and sulfidation for nickel recovery from a spent catalyst containing the chelating agent, 2,2′-bipyridine
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,7721-7727
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00470E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Hisanori Iwai, Mauricio Cordova, Yutaro Takaya, Naoki Yokota, Yuko Takahashi, Chiharu Tokoro
Techniques for recovering nickel (Ni) from various Ni-containing products are needed for resource circulation. The present study showed the Ni recovery performance for the spent Ni–bipyridine catalyst, revealing the influence of bipyridine.
